title: Core: AS2 trace() and FSCommand() built-ins
description: Verify AS2 built-in statements compile: trace('hello') emits ActionTrace (0x26). FSCommand('fullscreen', 'true') emits ActionGetURL2 (0x9A) or ActionCallFunction (0x3D). Also verify: _global.trace, undefined keyword, null keyword, Infinity, NaN literals. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/builtinstmts.test.ts.
